findings.finding: The real bar has dropped. findings.finding: Geely-sphere optionality. EFN reported on 31 Aug, from sources, that Geely could take a 'drastic decision' on Polestar; Geely denied any closure plan. Li Shufu controls about 60-66%, Geely took Zeekr private in 2025 at an 18.9% premium, and an Avanza strategist (16 Nov) raised a cheap buy-out by the main owners. A support or structural announcement with the release is possible.

findings.finding: A 6-K of 5 Nov 2026 discloses that Polestar Performance AB filed to convert cross-border into a Dutch B.V. to make the holding structure and 'distribution of capital within the group' more efficient, with operations staying in Gothenburg. This is a structural step during the closing delay with no figures attached.
